## Evidence and specifications

## Known acceptance criteria

<!-- List currently understood observable outcomes. Mark draft criteria as proposed.
Add or refine criteria through specification approval; do not invent details to fill the template. -->

## Open questions and dependencies

<!-- Record uncertainties, discovery needed, known blockers, and affected work.
An unresolved question blocks dependent tasks, not all unrelated work. -->

## Linked task issues

<!-- Add separate frontend/backend issues as concrete work and ownership emerge.
Use sub-issues or links such as "- [ ] #123 — Frontend: ...".
Add a separate integration issue when substantial. A small feature may stay in this issue.
An empty list means decomposition is pending, not that no work remains. -->

## Ownership and readiness

<!-- Feature owner: name or Unassigned.
State what is approved versus still under discussion. Before starting a task, establish
its owner, approved requirements, relevant contracts, acceptance checks and prerequisites.
The entire feature need not be decomposed before an independent ready task starts. -->

## Decisions and scope changes

<!-- Record dated decisions and specification/approval links.
Add discovered tasks with their reason and dependencies. Changes to approved behaviour,
scope or interfaces require the relevant human approval; shared changes require both owners.
Preserve completed task history and the existing failed-loop correction rules. -->

## Completion evidence

<!-- Fill in actual PR, review, integration and test evidence as work completes.
Close only after all required tasks AND feature-level acceptance checks are complete.
Unverified criteria must remain explicit; closed child issues alone are insufficient. -->
